versions.content: Transformation of ECU Resource template modeling accord- ing to the AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules Type: valid Description: The XML representation for the ECU Resource template shall be derived from its UML representation according to the AUTOSAR XML Schema Production Rules. Rationale: The experience and tools already available for the AUTOSAR Modeling shall be reused. Use Case: The ECU Resource template is similar to other templates already done with the AUTOSAR Metamodeling Guide. Dependencies: – Supporting Material: XML Schema Production Rules [8]
